hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Western Africa, bordering the North Atlantic Ocean, between Guinea-Bissau and Sierra Leone || generally flat coastal plain, hilly to mountainous interior || the Niger and its important tributary, the Milo River, have their sources in the Guinean highlands || Resources: bauxite, iron ore, diamonds, gold, uranium, hydropower, fish, salt || Exports: gold, aluminum ore, cocoa beans, crude petroleum, coconuts/brazil nuts/cashews (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: generally flat coastal plain, hilly to mountainous interior || Western Africa, bordering the North Atlantic Ocean, between Guinea-Bissau and Sierra Leone

climate.excerpt: generally hot and humid; monsoonal-type rainy season (June to November) with southwesterly winds; dry season (December to May) with northeasterly harmattan winds || hot, dry, dusty harmattan haze may reduce visibility during dry season

economy.excerpt: growing but primarily agrarian West African economy; major mining sector; improving fiscal and debt balances prior to COVID-19; economy increasingly vulnerable to climate change; slow infrastructure improvements; gender wealth and human capital gaps || Exports: gold, aluminum ore, cocoa beans, crude petroleum, coconuts/brazil nuts/cashews (2023) || Industries: bauxite, gold, diamonds, iron ore; light manufacturing, agricultural processing
